title: Alarms: dead letters, stuck unknowns, change feed lag, budget
description:
One alarm each, defined in the templates and read by the operator listener: a message in any agent dead-letter queue; a run that stays `unknown` and unacknowledged; a change feed whose iterator age grows; the site budget reached. Each alarm names the runbook line that says what to do.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Each condition raises its alarm in a test.
- Each alarm links to a runbook line.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- agent-alarms.feature: a dead-lettered wake alarms; an old unknown alarms; a lagging feed alarms; the budget flag raises once per cycle.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Alarms in the site backend and the shared stack.

**Part of:** Observability, safety and release readiness. Slice code J1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
